intro.name: Shifo
lines: 😘🎂 Happy Birthday meri jaan, meri Shifo ❤️🌹
📖 Aapko novels pasand hain, toh maine socha... 🌹
✨ Is dafa sirf birthday wish nahi... aapke liye ek kahani likhi jaye. ❤️
🌹 Ek aisi kahani jismein lafz kam aur ehsaas zyada hon. 🫶
📖 Jismein hamari chhoti chhoti baatein, care, hasi, narazgi aur mohabbat sab mehfooz ho. ❤️
🥰 Is novel ke do hi kirdar hain — Hami aur Shifo. 🌹
💌 Aur mohtarma... meri favourite kahani ka sab se khoobsurat kirdar aap hain. ❤️
♾️ Aur sab se khoobsurat baat? Yeh kahani abhi khatam nahi hui. 📖❤️
intro.highlight: 🌹❤️ Meri kahani ka sab se khoobsurat hissa... aap hain, Shifo. ❤️🌹

book.coverSubtitle: Hamari Woh Kahani Jo Abhi Baqi Hai
book.leftText: Do dil, kuch khoobsurat yaadein, thori si pagalpan, bohat saari care, izzat aur mohabbat... aur bohat se safhay jo abhi hum dono ne mil kar likhne hain. ❤️
book.rightText: Is kitab ka har safha aapki muskurahat, aapki khushi aur aapke sukoon ke naam. 🌹❤️

chapters.label: Page 01
chapters.title: Hamari first coversation 💌
chapters.text:
Har khoobsurat kahani ka ek pehla safha hota hai... 📖❤️

Hamari kahani ka woh safha tha:
17 December 2025 · 7:35 PM 🌙

Sirf ek message tha...
Ek chhoti si baat...
Ek aam sa lamha...

Lekin mohtarma, mujhe kya pata tha ke woh chhota sa message meri zindagi ki itni khoobsurat kahani ka pehla jumla ban jayega. 🥹❤️

Kabhi kabhi zindagi apni sab se pyari kahaniyan bohat khamoshi se shuru karti hai. 🌹

chapters.label: Page 02
chapters.title: Mera bolna par Dupatte Se Cover Karna - Mere Liye Bohat Bara Effort Tha 🥹❤️
chapters.text:
Shifo... 🌹❤️

Aapko yaad hai na...
main jab kehta tha,
"Apne sar par dupatta rakh liya karein..." 🤍

Main jaanta hoon,
aapke liye yeh kabhi kabhi bht mushkil hoti hai.
Lekin jab aap meri feelings samajh kar
mere liye yeh effort karti thin...
toh sach kahun,
mujhe lagta tha meri efforts, mohabbat ka sila mil gaya. 🥹❤️

Mujhe abhi bhi yaad hai...
Eid par Rimsha ke ghar ke ghar jata time maine kaha tha,
"Dupatta lein na..." 🌙❤️
Aur Danial jab Umrah se aaya tha,
us din bhi maine aapse wahi kaha tha.
or ek shadi ka event ma bhi
 🕊️

Aur Shifo... ek baat kahun? 🌹
Aap jab meri baat maan kar
apne baalon ko dupatte se dhak leti hain na...
toh mujhe dil mein ek ajeeb si khushi hoti hai. 🥹❤️

Shayad isliye ke aapki zulfein mujhe bohat pyari hain...
aur dil chahta hai ke unka woh khoobsurat sa didaar
sirf mera ho. ❤️🌹

Yeh kabhi aap par pressure nahi hai, mohtarma... 🤍
Yeh bas meri mohabbat hai,
meri apnayat hai,
aur woh chhoti si khwahish
jo main aapse pyaar se keh deta hoon. 🫶❤️

Aur jab aap meri feelings samajh kar
yeh chhota sa effort karti hain...
toh yaqeen karein,
mujhe bohat sukoon milta hai. 🌹

InshaAllah ek din...
meri yeh baat kehne ki bhi zaroorat nahi hogi. 🤲❤️
Aap khud apni khushi aur apni marzi se
apne sar ko dupatte se dhakengi...
aur main bas door se aapko dekh kar muskuraunga. 🥹🌹

Aur dil kahega...
"Mohtarma ne meri itni si mohabbat ko samajh liya." ❤️

Bas isi ehsaas ka naam mere liye mohabbat hai... 🫶🌹

chapters.label: Page 03
chapters.title: Haroon Ki Shaadi... Aur Meri Nazar Sirf Aap Par ❤️🌹
chapters.text:
Shifo... ❤️

Haroon ki shaadi ka woh waqt mujhe aaj bhi yaad hai. 🌹

Aap mere aas paas thi...
Aur sach kahun mohtarma?
Meri nazar baar baar aap hi ko dhoond rahi thi. 🥹❤️

Main chahe kitne hi logon ke beech khara hota...
Mehfil kitni hi busy kyun na hoti...
Lekin meri aankhon ka pata nahi kyun ek hi address tha... 🌹

Aap. ❤️

Baraat mein jab apka mood off hua tha...
toh ajeeb baat hai, mera mood bhi off hua aur aapki wajah se nahi...
phir bhi meri nazar aapko hi dhoond rahi thi. 🥹

Shayad jab koi dil ke qareeb aa jaye na,
toh uski presence bhi dil ke mood se judi hoti hai. ❤️

Aur phir woh Mayoon... 🌙🌹

Mujhe abhi tak yaad hai...
Mayoon mein sab apni jagah khoobsurat lag rahe thay,
lekin meri nazar mein sab se khoobsurat kaun tha?

Aap. ❤️

Phir Walima... 🥹🌹

Uff... mohtarma, aap kya lag rahi thi. ❤️
Main shayad lafzon mein woh baat kabhi theek se bata hi nahi sakta.

Har event mein log bohat thay...
Har taraf roshni thi...
Har taraf khoobsurti thi...
Lekin meri nazar ke liye ek hi chehra sab se alag tha. 🥹❤️

Aur mujhe ek aur baat yaad hai...
valima par meri aap se pehli gift mile thi. 😂❤️

Woh watch...
Uff woh watch. ⌚😂

Aaj bhi mere paas hai.

Kuch cheezein sirf cheezein nahi hotin...
woh kisi khoobsurat waqt ki nishani ban jaati hain. ❤️

Aur woh watch mere liye bhi kuch aisi hi hai.

Kabhi kabhi main sochta hoon...
Kitni ajeeb khoobsurat baat hai na?
Ek event...
Kuch lamhe...
Ek chhoti si guftagu apka salam or mera jawab dyna...
Aur phir wahi chhoti chhoti yaadein dil mein itni gehri jagah bana leti hain. 🌹❤️

mohtarma...
Aapko shayad pata bhi na ho,
lekin un tamam events mein meri nazar baar baar sirf aap par rukti thi. 🥹

Aur shayad isi liye...
woh din mere liye sirf kisi shaadi ke din nahi thay.

Woh meri kahani ke khoobsurat safhay thay. 📖❤️

chapters.label: Page 04
chapters.title: hamari Meetup ke yadain🌸
chapters.text:
Hum sirf do baar saamne mile hain... ❤️

Ek baar park mein... 🌳
Aur ek baar restaurant mein... ☕🌹

Shayad kisi aur ke liye do mulaqatein bohat kam hon.
Lekin mere liye un dono lamhon mein bhi ek poori kahani chhupi hui hai. 🥹

Woh nazrein...
Woh halka sa sharmaana...
Woh chhoti chhoti baatein...
Aur woh moments jo waqt guzar jaane ke baad bhi dil mein wahi ke wahi rehte hain. ❤️

Kuch mulaqatein waqt ke saath khatam nahi hotin...
Woh yaadon mein aur gehri hoti jaati hain. 🌹

chapters.label: Page 05
chapters.title: Aapki Care 🫶
chapters.text:
Shifo...
Aapki sab se khoobsurat baat mujhe aapki care lagti hai. ❤️

Aapka mere liye fikr karna...
Meri chhoti si baat ko bhi seriously lena...
Meri khamoshi ko mehsoos karna...
Yeh sab mere liye bohat qeemti hai. 🫶

Ek din humari larai hui thi.
Main university mein tha aur meri bike theek nahi chal rahi thi. 🥺

Maine kaha tha ke Messenger active rahega aur main ek ghante baad phone check karunga.

Jab maine phone dekha...
aap chat mein thi. ❤️

Us waqt mujhe mehsoos hua ke kuch log sirf baat nahi karte...
woh dil se fikr bhi karte hain. 🌹

Aur mohtarma...
Aapki woh care main kabhi nahi bhoolunga. ❤️

chapters.label: Page 06
chapters.title: Meri Birthday Par Aapki Mohabbat... 🥹❤️
chapters.text:
Shifo... 🌹❤️

Meri birthday yaad hai aapko? 🎂🥹

Mere liye woh sirf ek birthday nahi tha...
woh pehli dafa thi jab maine mehsoos kiya
ke kisi ne meri khushi ke liye
itna socha hai. ❤️🫶

Aapke woh long birthday messages... 💌
Aapki apni awaaz mein woh video... 🎥❤️
Meri pictures ka woh chhota sa album... 📸🌹
Happy Birthday wali woh video... 🎂✨
Aur phir mera birthday gift box... 🎁🥹

Har cheez mein aapka effort tha.
Har cheez mein aapka waqt tha.
Aur sab se zyada...
har cheez mein aapki mohabbat thi. ❤️

Mohtarma... 🌹
shayad aapko andaza bhi nahi
ke mere liye yeh sab kitna special tha.

Kyun ke yeh pehli dafa tha...
meri birthday par kisi ne
mere liye itni mohabbat se
itni saari cheezein sochi aur banayi thin. 🥹❤️

Main har cheez dekh kar bas yahi sochta tha...
"Aapne mere liye itna sab kiya." 🫶🥹

Aapki awaaz mein meri birthday wish sunna... ❤️
meri pictures ko itne pyaar se album mein dekhna... 🌹
woh video baar baar dekhna... 🎥
Aur woh gift box... 🎁❤️

Sab kuch mere liye ek yaad ban gaya.

Shifo, mohabbat sirf "I love you" kehne ka naam nahi... ❤️
Kabhi kabhi mohabbat kisi ke liye
apna waqt nikalne mein hoti hai,
kisi ki khushi ke liye mehnat karne mein hoti hai,
aur kisi ko yeh mehsoos karane mein hoti hai
ke woh aapke liye waqai khaas hai. 🫶🌹

Aur aapne mujhe woh sab mehsoos karaya. 🥹❤️

Sach kahun...
us din mujhe gift box se zyada
uske peeche chhupi aapki mohabbat mili thi. 🎁❤️

Aur woh mohabbat...
mere liye aaj bhi bohat qeemti hai. 🌹🥹

Meri birthday ki sab se khoobsurat yaad...
shayad birthday nahi,
balki aapka woh effort hai. ❤️🫶

Aapne meri ek date ko...
ek khoobsurat yaad bana diya. 🎂🌹

Aur Shifo...
agar kabhi main aapko yeh bata na paun
ke woh sab mere liye kitna special tha,
toh bas itna yaad rakhna...

Maine aapka har effort dekha tha. ❤️
Har cheez dil se mehsoos ki thi. 🥹
Aur shayad isi liye...
woh birthday meri favourite yaadon mein se ek ban gaya. 🌹❤️

Aapki woh mohabbat,
aapki woh care,
aur mere liye ki gayi woh chhoti chhoti koshishein...
meri kahani ka bohat hi khoobsurat safha hain. 📖❤️

chapters.label: Page 07
chapters.title: Meri Shifa - my heart❤️🌹
chapters.text:
Aap emotional hain... 🥹❤️

Funny hain... 😂

Shy hain... 🤭

Caring hain... 🫶

Introvert hain... 🌙

Aur bohat quiet bhi... 🤍

Aapko novels pasand hain... 📖
Flowers pasand hain... 🌹
Black aapka favourite hai... 🖤
Peaceful places pasand hain... 🕊️
Makeup aapka hobby hai... 💄
Aur chicken karahi... 🍗😂❤️

Aur jab aap gussa hoti hain...
Allah bachaye, mohtarma. 😭😂❤️

Lekin sach kahun?
In sab cheezon ko mila kar jo Shifo banti hain...
woh meri favourite hain. ❤️🌹

chapters.label: Page 08
chapters.title: Jab Aap "Hami" Kehti Hain ❤️
chapters.text:
Pata nahi kyun...
Lekin jab aap mujhe "Hami" kehti hain na... 🥹❤️

Toh woh naam aapki awaaz mein kuch aur hi lagta hai.
Jaise ek simple sa naam bhi aapke lehje mein apni koi alag kahani rakhta ho. 🌹

Aur jab main kehta hoon:
"Duppatta rakh lijiye."
Aur aap meri baat maan leti hain...

Toh dil ko ek ajeeb sa sukoon milta hai. 🫶

Shayad mohabbat hamesha bade alfaaz mein nahi hoti...
Kabhi kabhi woh isi tarah ki chhoti chhoti care mein chhupi hoti hai. ❤️

chapters.label: Page 09
chapters.title: Aapka "Hmm" 😂❤️
chapters.text:
Aapki dictionary mein ek bohat special word hai... 😂❤️

"Hmm."

Aap gusse mein hain...
Hmm. 😭

Normal hain...
Hmm. 😂

Aur main aapko tang kiye baghair kaise reh sakta hoon? 🤭

"Hmm hmm hmm hmm... ka matlab hai mera mehboob?" 😂❤️

Aur aap:
"Aisa kuch nahi." 😭😂

Bas mohtarma...
Isi tarah ke chhote chhote pagal moments hi toh meri favourite memories hain. 🥹❤️

Kuch yaadein bohat badi nahi hotin...
Bas bohat apni hoti hain. 🌹
